description.en: Sakura, the last surviving princess of a fallen kingdom, is being hunted down for the power of Ambrosia she possesses - the ability to grant divine strength, but only to a human. With no human companion, she decides to summon one from another world in a desperate attempt to find a knight to protect her, but the man who answers her call is less than what she had hoped for.
description.ja: アダール侯国の生き残りであるサクラ姫が異世界より召喚したのは平凡な青年カイ・ワタリ！だが彼は呪乳（ネクタール）を吸うことで恐るべき戦士へと変身する……！！
description.pt-br: Sakura, a última princesa de um reino caído está sendo caçada devido ao poder de ambrosia que possui- habilidade a qual concede força divina, mas apenas aos humanos. Sem nenhum companheiro humano enquanto fugia, ela se viu obrigada a invocar desesperadamente um cavaleiro de outro mundo para se proteger, mas o homem que ela acaba invocando aparenta ser muito menos do que ela gostaria do que fosse. Conseguirá Sakura se proteger?

description.en: How young is too young to fall in love? How old is too old to fall in love? Who decides the end of the flowery days of youth and the beginning of the same? In the eastern part of Tokyo, at a supermarket in a town zero meters above sea level. A chance encounter for two people over the cashier's counter.
description.ja:
人を好きになることも、ましてや結婚なんて疾うに諦めた、ラブソングが苦手なフリーの作詞家・花田和己 ３６歳。醒めた風を勝手に感じていた引っ越してきた町のスーパーマーケットで、彼は一人の女性に出会う。人を好きにならないと決めた人と、未だ人を好きになる事を知らない人。スーパーマーケットのレジカウンター越しに何かが始まるのかもしれない……

青春の終わりを、始まりを、誰が決めるのか―――
description.zh: 什么时候开始恋爱才好、什么时候结束恋爱才好。青春的序幕与尾曲又是什么人决定的呢？在东京的某处小商街里，有个恋爱故事在超市的收银台边拉开了序幕

description.en:
A prodigy of science and a solitary genius—yet terrible at so many things!?

Poor university student Sanosuke Saraki unexpectedly reunites with his admired genius classmate, Koharu Kobachi, at his part-time job back at his old school. However, this supposed genius is now a "5th year high school student" who has repeated her second year in a row...! Saraki's mission is to "make Koharu graduate by the end of the year."
description.ja: 科学の申し子にして孤高の天才──だけど、ニガテなことだらけ!? 貧乏大学生の佐良木佐ノ介は、アルバイト先の母校にて、憧れていた天才同級生・小鉢古春と思わぬ再会を果たす。しかし天才であるはずの彼女は今、２連続で留年中の「高校5年生」になっていた…！ 佐良木に与えられたミッションは「今年中に古春を卒業させる」こと。一つ屋根の下で２０歳の高校生とやり直す、青春物語！
description.pt-br:
Uma prodígio da ciência e uma gênio solitária — mas péssima em tantas coisas!? 

O pobre estudante universitário Sanosuke Saraki reencontra inesperadamente sua admirada colega gênio, Koharu Kobachi, em seu emprego de meio período na sua antiga escola. No entanto, essa suposta gênio é agora uma "estudante do 5º ano do ensino médio" que repetiu o segundo ano pela segunda vez consecutiva...! A missão de Saraki é "fazer Koharu se formar até o final do ano." Uma história de amadurecimento sobre recomeçar com uma estudante de ensino médio de 20 anos sob o mesmo teto!

description.en:
What happens when next door to upcoming mangaka Fujiwara moves Yuuki, who was his teacher back in high school and first crush?

Yuuki, now a married woman, is starting a new life in the city, however her husband is always away on business trips. She finds comfort in the company of her former student, but what she doesn't realize is that Fujiwara can listen to everything happening in her apartment through the building's thin walls...
description.ja: 東京。繁華街から離れた閑静な住宅街で連載漫画家を目指す青年・藤原秋。ある日、隣の部屋に新たな住人が引っ越してきた。その隣人は藤原の高校の恩師・仲井間真。偶然の再会に喜ぶ二人。しかしその晩。藤原は耳にする。隣の部屋から漏れる、仲井間の嬌声。自らの欲望を抑えられず、藤原は隣室を覗き込む。そこにはかつての恩師のあられもない姿が…!?隣人愛欲物語。淫靡の世界の幕がいま、開く。
description.pt-br:
O que acontece quando, ao lado do apartamento de Fujiwara, um aspirante a mangaká, se muda Yuuki, sua antiga professora e primeiro amor do ensino médio? 

Yuuki, agora casada, inicia uma nova vida na cidade, mas com o marido viajando frequentemente a negócios, encontra conforto na companhia de seu antigo aluno.  O que ela não percebe é que as paredes finas do prédio permitem que Fujiwara ouça tudo o que acontece no apartamento ao lado...

description.en: Shi Nidie transmigrated into the mistress of the Pleasure Palace! Originally, she planned on surviving by:  guiding the overpowered male lead Nie Guixun on his path to become a hero, help ignite passion in the lazy prodigal He Lanshan, change the tragic fate of the tsundere Dan Jiudeng, and save the loyal dog Yun Lin from certain death. To carry out her plan, she decided to take all four in as disciples, founding a new sect which defied fate and aimed to rewrite destiny. Watch Shi Nidie as she embarks on her chaotic journey of building a reverse-harem. Where she expands and strengthens the power of the Pleasure Palace!

description.en:
Asahi Nishizono has finally made her high school debut. But ever since she was a little girl, she's never been able to forget her first love, You Kazami. Even now, she can't take her eyes off his handsome face...

...or so she thought, until a huge shadow suddenly blocks her view.

“WHOA! JUUMONJI?!”

That's Touya Juumonji, Kazami's childhood friend who's always by his side. Not only is he huge, he's also ridiculously talented at all sorts of things. And somehow, Juumonji always manages to steal Nishizono's view of Kazami...?!

Caelius , a high-ranking lord among vampire nobility, undergoes an unexpected transformation while investigating anomalies within their territory. During the crisis, they cross paths with a young werewolf named Rehgar, forming an inextricable bond. Though their races are sworn enemies, the two are forced to embark on a journey together to uncover the truth behind the hidden darkness festering within the vampire realm. Along the way, their connection evolves from a mere contractual relationship into that of inseparable soulmates.
Ryuuichi is a high-school student tired of living in a small town with small people. He'll do whatever he can to get money, power, and women.

altTitles.en: The Little Junior Sister Doesn't Want to Ascend

description.en:
Sealed inside a secret realm for three hundred years, the notorious archvillain has finally been released by a massive fool. Jin Xun bursts into a wild laughter. He prepares to make his triumphant return and settle an old grudge— huh? What happened to his maxed-out cultivation level? What happened to all of his divine-grade artifacts? Why is no one obeying his commands anymore?! 

As long as Su Yuan stays by Jin Xu's side, her constantly depleting cultivation returns to normal. In order to survive, Su Yuan decides to tightly cling onto Jin Xun by offering him every treasure in the world— as long as he stays by her side, of course. However, just being near her makes Jin Xun lose all of his powers and causes him to become as weak as an ordinary person. In order to seek his revenge, he has to leave her... Until Su Yuan tightly binds him with her Immortal-binding rope.

Su Yuan: Quit struggling. In this lifetime, you and I are never going to be apart!
Jin Xun: I'll never give up my quest for revenge just for the sake of love!   
(A few days later…)  
Jin Xun: Fine, I accept you.
Su Yuan: ？？？？？？

They were childhood friends, and she had always been more powerful than him. But when they accidentally traveled (summoned?) to another world, it was finally time for him to become the knight in shining armor! He had to find her first though, since they were separated… Come and witness his fight to be better in a crazy world where monsters roamed and technology was so advanced your amputated limbs could be restored to perfection…

description.en:
Kureha Senpai, who loves alcohol, becomes even more enchanting and seductive once she starts drinking... my reasoning is about to explode! The two of us, deeply caring for each other, grow bolder in our affection whether we’re drinking at home or out, using every trick in the book to flirt and get closer!
___
**Character Designer:** [Monoto](https://mangadex.org/author/96b3bbe2-e878-4dee-9573-26aadbc78b3f)
description.ja: 「私たち、そろそろ同居してみない？」二十歳の誕生日に、一つ年上の恋人・紅葉先輩から誘われ始まった同居生活。キスすらまだな俺たちだったけど、お酒が大好きな先輩は酔うとどんどん大胆になって…！？宅飲みでも外飲みでも、甘えてきたりからかってきたりと刺激的な先輩に、俺の理性はもう限界です！！
description.vi:
Sống chung với một cô bạn gái đàn chị nghịch ngợm quả thật là đầy ắp những điều phấn khích!
“Chúng ta thử sống cùng nhau nhé?” – đó là câu hỏi mà bạn gái của tôi, Kureha Senpai, bất ngờ đưa ra đúng ngày tôi tròn hai mươi tuổi.

Từ khoảnh khắc đó, cuộc sống chung ngọt ngào bắt đầu, khoảng cách giữa chúng tôi gần như bằng không! Kureha Senpai vốn đã quyến rũ, nhưng mỗi khi uống rượu lại càng thêm mê hoặc, khiến lý trí tôi như sắp nổ tung!

Chúng tôi yêu thương nhau hết mực, chẳng ngại bày tỏ tình cảm từ khi ở nhà đến lúc ra ngoài, luôn tìm đủ mọi cách để gần gũi và trêu ghẹo nhau. Đây là một câu chuyện tình hài lãng mạn, vừa tinh nghịch vừa trong sáng, về đôi tình nhân chẳng thể kiềm chế được tình yêu của mình, cùng nhau trải qua những ngày tháng đầy hứng khởi!
description.pt-br: Morar junto com minha namorada mais velha é incrível! "Que tal a gente começar a morar juntos?" Foi essa a pergunta que minha namorada Kureha Senpai me fez no meu aniversário de 20 anos. Daquele dia em diante, começamos a morar juntos, e tem praticamente zero vergonha entre nós! Kureha Senpai, que ama beber, fica ainda mais sedutora e encantadora quando começa a beber... Minha sanidade está por um fio! Nós dois que realmente nos amamos, ficamos cada vez mais ousados um com o outro quando começamos a beber em casa ou quando saímos juntos. Usamos todas as artimanhas possíveis para flertar e nos aproximar! Uma comédia romântica levemente ousada e pura, sobre um casal que simplesmente não consegue conter o amor que sente um pelo outro, vivendo dias cheios de emoção!

description.en: Kazuma Suzuki was just your average high schooler—until his childhood friend, Rua Takayashiki, a beautiful, sharp-tongued girl who also happened to be the granddaughter of the school chairman and the nation's top idol, cut all ties with him using a line straight out of a drama. Forced into submission for years as her so-called childhood friend, Kazuma decides it's finally time for his first-ever rebellion. He's done playing lapdog. This time, he's taking back his freedom—and aiming for a normal school life. Escaping a powerful beauty like her is easier said than done...
description.fr:
Kazuma Suzuki était juste un lycéen ordinaire, jusqu’à ce que son amie d’enfance, Rua Takayashiki, une fille magnifique à la langue bien pendue, qui se trouve aussi être la petite-fille du président de l’école et la plus grande idole du pays, coupe tout contact avec lui en lançant une réplique digne d’un drama.

Forcé à se soumettre pendant des années sous le titre d’"ami d’enfance", Kazuma décide qu’il est enfin temps de se rebeller pour la première fois de sa vie. Il en a fini de jouer les toutous dociles. Cette fois, il reprend sa liberté — et vise une vie scolaire normale.

Mais échapper à une beauté aussi puissante qu’elle… est plus facile à dire qu’à faire.
description.id:
Kazuma Suzuki hanyalah siswa SMA biasa—sampai sahabat masa kecilnya, Rua Takayashiki, seorang gadis cantik berlidah tajam yang juga merupakan cucu dari kepala sekolah dan idola nasional, memutuskan semua hubungan dengannya menggunakan dialog yang diambil dari sebuah drama.

Dipaksa tunduk selama bertahun-tahun sebagai apa yang disebut sahabat masa kecilnya, Kazuma memutuskan bahwa inilah saatnya untuk pemberontakan pertamanya. Ia sudah selesai menjadi anjing piaraan. Kali ini, ia mengambil kembali kebebasannya—dan mengincar kehidupan sekolah yang normal.

Melarikan diri dari wanita cantik yang kuat seperti dia lebih mudah diucapkan daripada dilakukan...
description.ja: 日本でもトップクラスの才能が集う通称“Ｓ級学園”に通う、自称どこにでもいる少年、鈴木和真は現役トップアイドルにして理事長の孫という名実ともに学園のトップに君臨する幼なじみの高慢性悪美少女、高屋敷瑠亜から「アンタと幼なじみってだけでもイヤなのにw」とクラスメイトの面前でバカにされ笑いものにされる。「ああ、俺もだよ」と瑠亜との絶縁を宣言した和真は今まで絶対服従を強いられてきた人生から脱却し、普通の学園生活を目指すことに。しかし和真は実は普通とは程遠い規格外のチート級能力の持ち主で本人の自覚もないまま学園のＳ級美少女たちからモテまくることに…！？
description.vi: Suzuki Kazuma, nhân vật chính bình thường, đã bị cô lập bởi Takayashiki Rua,một cô gái xinh đẹp nhưng hãm l*n, cháu cưng của hiệu trưởng trường và có quyền lực lẫn danh tiếng lớn như một thần tượng hàng đầu. Cho đến bây giờ, anh ta đã bị buộc phải ở vị trí vâng lời tuyệt đối với tư cách là một người bạn thời thơ ấu của Rua, nhưng lần đầu tiên trong đời, anh ta quyết định nổi dậy và nhắm đến cuộc đời bình yên cho bản thân mình…

biography.en: **Name In Native Language:** とうのきり

description.de: Eine Geschichte über eine Oberschülerin, die sich in ihre Kindheitsfreundin verliebt hat.
description.en: A story about a high school girl who fell for her childhood friend.

The enormous cave system, known as the Abyss, is the last unexplored place in the world. Nobody knows how deep down goes this titanic pit, inhabited by strange and wondrous creatures and full of mysterious ancient relics which purpose in unknown to modern man. Generations of bold adventurers have been drawn by the cryptic depths of the Abyss. In course of time those brave enough to explore the dangerous pit came to be known as "Delvers."

In Orth, the town at the edge of the Abyss, there lives a little orphan named Riko, who dreams of becoming as great a delver as her mother was and solving the great mystery of the pit. One day, exploring the murky depths, she stumbles upon a little boy who turns out to be a robot...
description.ja:
隅々まで探索されつくした世界に、唯一残された秘境の大穴『アビス』。どこまで続くとも知れない深く巨大なその縦穴には、奇妙奇怪な生物たちが生息し、今の人類では作りえない貴重な遺物が眠っている。「アビス」の不可思議に満ちた姿は人々を魅了し、冒険へと駆り立てた。そうして幾度も大穴に挑戦する冒険者たちは、次第に『探窟家』呼ばれるようになっていった。

アビスの縁に築かれた街『オース』に暮らす孤児のリコは、いつか母のような偉大な探窟家になり、アビスの謎を解き明かすことを夢見ていた。そんなある日、リコはアビスを探窟中に、少年の姿をしたロボットを拾い…？
description.ka: უზარმაზარი გამოქვაბულების სისტემა, რომელიც ცნობილია როგორც უფსკრული, არის ბოლო შეუსწავლელი ადგილი მსოფლიოში. არავინ იცის, რამდენად ღრმად მიდის ეს ტიტანური ორმო, დასახლებული უცნაური და გასაოცარი არსებებით და სავსე იდუმალი უძველესი რელიქვიებით, რომელთა დანიშნულება თანამედროვე ადამიანისთვის უცნობია. თამამი ავანტიურისტთა თაობები მიზიდული იქნა უფსკრულის იდუმალი სიღრმეებით. დროთა განმავლობაში მათ, ვინც საკმარისად გაბედულები გამოიკვლიეს სახიფათო ორმო, გახდნენ ცნობილი როგორც "დელვერები". ორთში, უფსკრულის პირას მდებარე ქალაქში, ცხოვრობს პატარა ობოლი, სახელად რიკო, რომელიც ოცნებობს გახდეს ისეთივე დიდი დელვერი, როგორც დედამისი იყო და ამოხსნას ორმოს დიდი საიდუმლო. ერთ დღეს, ბუნდოვანი სიღრმეების შესწავლისას, ის წააწყდება პატარა ბიჭს, რომელიც აღმოჩნდება, რომ რობოტია…
description.ru: Огромная пещерная система, известная как Бездна, является последним неисследованным местом в мире. В этой титанической яме обитают странные и удивительные существа. Она полна таинственных древних реликвий, предназначение которых неизвестно современному человеку. Поколения смелых авантюристов были затянуты загадочными глубинами Бездны. Со временем достаточно храбрые, чтобы исследовать опасную яму, стали известны как «Исследователи Бездны». В Оосу, городе на краю Бездны, живет маленькая сирота по имени Рико, которая мечтает стать великим пещерным налетчиком, каким была ее мать, и разгадать великую тайну ямы. Однажды, исследуя темные глубины, она натыкается на маленького мальчика, который оказывается роботом...
description.es-la: El enorme sistema de cuevas, conocido como El Abismo, es el último lugar inexplorado en el mundo. Nadie sabe que tan profundo es este agujero titánico, habitado por extrañas y maravillosas criaturas y lleno de misterio y reliquias antiguas de propósito desconocido para la humanidad. Generaciones de valientes aventureros han sido atraídos a las profundidades cripticas del Abismo. Con el paso del tiempo estos exploradores son conocidos como "Exploradores de las Profundidades". En Oath, el pueblo al borde del Abismo, vive una pequeña niña huérfana llamada Riko, que sueña con convertirse en una gran exploradora como su madre y descubrir los misterios del Abismo. Un día explorando las obscuras profundidades se encuentra con un niño, que resulta ser un robot...

biography.en:
Shigeya Suzuki, more commonly known under his pseudonym Tsukushi Akihito, is a Japanese illustrator, mangaka and designer from the Kanagawa Prefecture. He worked at Konami from 2000 to 2010 before becoming a freelance illustrator. During his time at Konami, he primarily worked in the animation and designing of the interface for titles such as [Elebits](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elebits), and the character design for [Elebits: The Adventures of Kai and Zero](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elebits:_The_Adventures_of_Kai_and_Zero) and the anime [Fairy Musketeers](https://myanimelist.net/anime/607/Otogi_Juushi_Akazukin).

After leaving Konami, Tsukushi began drawing manga, debuting in 2011 in with the doujinshi **Star Strings Yori**, and later on 2012, Takeshobo began serializing his manga [Made in Abyss](https://webcomicgamma.takeshobo.co.jp/manga/madeinabyss/) on their Web Comic Gamma website, which time later would receive an [anime adaptation](http://miabyss.com/) in 2017 covering the contents from volumes 1 through 3. Two compilation films, titled Made in Abyss: Journey's Dawn and Made in Abyss: Wandering Twilight were released on January 4, 2019 and January 18, 2019, respectively. A movie titled Made in Abyss Movie: Dawn of the Deep Soul was released in 2020 covering the contents of volumes 4 to 6.

description.en:
Sato Itto, an ordinary salaryman, has been shy about love due to an old trauma. Then one day, a reunion is held for the first time in several years. While they are having a good time talking about the good old days, suddenly Hebo, who has become an idol currently on hiatus, decides to attend the reunion!

Sato is upset to see Hebo, who was his first love. He manages to get over it with the help of alcohol, which he does not normally drink. When he wakes up, he finds the two of them naked in the same bed. As Sato desperately tries to recall his memories, Hebo shockingly says to him...!

"Marry me..."

What will happen to the marriage between the two who have no experience with love...!?
description.ja:
いたって普通のサラリーマンの佐藤一途（さとういっと）は昔のトラウマで恋に奥手になっていた。そんなある日、数年ぶりに同窓会が開かれることに。昔話に花を咲かせていると、急にアイドル休止ほやほやの枦保（へぼ）さんが出席することに!? 初恋の人だった枦保さんを前に動揺する佐藤。普段の飲まないお酒の力を借りてなんとか乗り切るも目を覚ますと同じベッドに裸の二人。必死に記憶を思い出そうとする佐藤に枦保さんから衝撃の一言が…！

「結婚して…」

恋愛偏差値0同士の結婚の行方は果たして―――！？
description.vi:
Sato Itto, một nhân viên văn phòng bình thường, luôn e dè trong chuyện tình cảm vì một vết thương lòng trong quá khứ. Một ngày nọ, anh tham gia buổi họp lớp sau nhiều năm xa cách. Khi mọi người đang vui vẻ ôn lại kỷ niệm cũ, bất ngờ Hebo – người từng là mối tình đầu của Sato, nay đã trở thành một idol đang tạm ngừng hoạt động – cũng xuất hiện!

Sato bối rối khi gặp lại Hebo, nhưng nhờ men rượu – thứ mà anh hiếm khi uống – anh dần buông bỏ sự ngại ngùng. Đến khi tỉnh dậy, anh phát hiện cả hai đang nằm chung giường, không một mảnh vải che thân. Khi Sato cố gắng nhớ lại chuyện gì đã xảy ra, Hebo bất ngờ lên tiếng:

"Cưới em đi..."

Cuộc hôn nhân giữa hai người chưa từng có kinh nghiệm yêu đương sẽ ra sao...?
description.pt-br:
Sato Itto, um assalariado comum, tem sido tímido em relação ao amor devido a um trauma antigo. Então, um dia, uma reunião é realizada pela primeira vez em vários anos. Enquanto eles se divertem conversando sobre os bons e velhos tempos, de repente Hebo, que se tornou uma Idol que está atualmente em hiato, decide participar da reunião!

Sato fica chateado ao ver Hebo, que foi seu primeiro amor. Ele consegue superar isso com a ajuda de álcool, que normalmente não bebe. Quando acorda, encontra os dois nus na mesma cama. Enquanto Sato tenta desesperadamente se lembrar de suas memórias, Hebo lhe diz, de forma chocante...!

“Se case comigo...”

O que acontecerá com o casamento entre os dois que não têm experiência com o amor...?

description.en:
One tomboy is determined to win the heart of her childhood best friend–but will it take more than a makeover to win him over?

Wakaba is cocky, condescending, foul-mouthed, and absolutely in love with her childhood friend, Daiki. For as long as they’ve known each other, Wakaba’s been the very image of a roughhousing tomboy, but all that’s about to change. When she shows up in front of him, wearing a cutesy, feminine outfit, will she get the hopeless late bloomer’s heart racing? When you can’t put your feelings into words, an image change might just be the right gambit!

*Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, Vol. 1*
description.ja:
いつも偉そうな幼馴染の女の子が実は俺のことを大好きで！？

女子が苦手な高校生・大樹は幼馴染のボーイッシュ女子・若葉とだけは仲良し。上から目線で生意気で口の悪い若葉と、放課後いつもサッカーをして過ごしていた。でもある日、若葉がとびきり可愛い服装で現れて、女子として意識してしまい…！？
description.es-la: Daiki, un chico de preparatoria al que no le va muy bien con las chicas, solo puede hablar con Wakaba, una chica a la que conoce desde la infancia. Pero un día, Wakaba aparece con un vestido ¿extraordinariamente lindo...?
description.pt-br:
Quatro-olhos, que não se dá bem com garotas, só consegue conversar com seu amigo de infância moleca, Wakaba. Mas um dia Wakaba aparece diante dele com uma roupa incrivelmente fofa...!?

Esta é uma comédia romântica de batalha entre Wakaba, que quer ser amado, e Quatro-Olhos, que fica nervoso com garotas!!

description.en:
Kidnapped by her ex-boyfriend, only the stalker is in the know!  
  
The fitting model Ju Yeon, who had just emerged as a star on social media, wakes up to find herself tied up in a dark school. Her kidnapper, a man named Nam Woo, is her ex-boyfriend. Ju Yeon had just reached a turning point in her life. But while she was being threatened by her ex-boyfriend at that moment, Ju Yeon's stalker, Park Su, was watching the two while keeping his mouth shut inside the shadows!
